title: Skip this if you have high particle count in your water, you'll be replacing the filter weekly!
text:
Skip this if you have high particle count in your water, you'll be replacing the filter weekly!. 2 person household, after a week of using this- it starts smelling fishy... I google it and find out that the same bacteria that makes fish smell nasty when they die, it's in water and these filters will trap that in there and your water will start smelling fishy if you don't keep the filter changed. So a filter a week if you have higher counts of contaminants. I have city water which is well treated but I wanted something to get the chlorine and such out- apparently this just isn't an option for us. Going back to our Brita filter that has a filter that lasts a year and you just change out the charcoal puck filter every now and again. It filters chlorine and such out of it and isn't zero tds but it's more sustainable price wise and the water tastes better than this zero stuff.

And no you can't clean this filter in this if it starts smelling fishy- it'll break down if you put anything like peroxide in it for some reason. I did it for an experiment and it got rid of the smell but everything in this zero filter broke down and it no longer passed water after that. It was very odd. But if you don't mind the price point and idea of changing the filter weekly, this could be for you. Too costly for us though!

product_metadata.title: InvisiClean Filtered Water Pitcher with TDS Meter Included - Zero TDS Rated Filter
features: Large Size Water Pitcher - Holds up to 8 cups of water and filters 2 cups at a time. One filter included. Use the included TDS meter to measure water quality before and after filtering to see the change for yourself. Please change filters when TDS goes above 5ppm or the taste/odor of the water changes. Interval varies depending on incoming tap water quality. If you are concerned about mineral depletion, please use a pinch of sea salt after removing all impurities.

5 Stage Water Filtration - Zero TDS (Total Dissolved Solids) - Most water filters only remove chlorine or odors from your water. Lab tested using NSF certification standards. Our 5 stage filter is designed to remove chemicals and contaminants such as chlorine, lead, iron, arsenic, cadmium, copper, mercury, fluoride, barium, cobalt, lithium, manganese, zinc, aluminum, and nickel. Our filter will ensure you get the best quality water for you and your family.

Many Uses - 0 TDS water can be used in many cases where hard water or contaminated water are not desirable. Our pitchers make the purest water for use in humidifiers, aroma diffusers, irons, Venus Flytrap plants, coffee machines, baby formula, ice cubes, pets, aquariums, car cooling systems, CPAP machines, spot-free rinse water & more.
